user.title: Connect a Xiaozhi agent
user.description: Gives the agent a few simple tools (list devices, turn on, turn off, get state, set temperature) for the devices picked below.

data_description.endpoint: From xiaozhi.me: Agent -> Configure -> Extensions -> MCP Endpoint. Looks like wss://api.xiaozhi.me/mcp/?token=... Keep it secret.
data_description.entities: Only these devices can be seen or controlled by voice. Fewer devices means fewer wrong picks.

error.invalid_endpoint: Must be a ws:// or wss:// address containing token=.
